metric.loudness: ITU-R BS.1770-4 gated integrated loudness (LUFS), K-weighting designed analytically, 400 ms blocks / 75% overlap, -70 LUFS absolute + -10 LU relative gate
metric.rms: unweighted broadband RMS over the whole render, dBFS (cross-check for windowed live-path probes)
metric.peak: sample peak in dBFS (true-peak/oversampled metering is NOT implemented)
metric.trimPlacement: master trim applied pre-limiter (same relative position as the live engine)
metric.note: the gate ignores silence-between-hits, which is why sparse genres read far higher in LUFS than in windowed RMS
